name: Iron Expanse
look: a sleek white robot Palkia banded in violet with gunmetal arms, long striped wing blades and a floating halo of a violet star round a dark starry lens
entry: A Pokémon resembling Palkia, recorded in a report about a machine that folded space around itself. The halo above it is a window onto a sky no one has ever seen.
how: Wild: very rare on the End's small islands.
